text:
ana_chen: quick heads-up — Orbit onboarding shows ~3x embeddings burn this week vs baseline. QBR with them Tue 4/12. Need spend forecast + escalation play before renewal score drifts red.

mike_fin: can you share account id + usage window? I can run a projection and patch the forecast sheet.

ana_chen: acct: ORBIT-458, window: last 14d. baseline ~ $1.2k/mo, current run-rate ~ $8.6k/mo. main driver is an async embed pipeline. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/ORBIT-458/usage

ops_bot: :warning: alert created: embeddings_rate_spike ORBIT-458 — triggered 3x in 24h. incident: https://incidents.redwood.ai/alerts/8672

julia_se: onboarding notes — they shipped a bulk ingest job on 3/28 that chunks full-text into 512-token windows. asked them to stagger and monitor. renewal touchpoint 2026-05-01.

sam_eng: quick wins we can push today: reduce embed batch size 10k -> 2k, enable prefix caching for repeated docs, and set default model to text-embedding-3-small (8-bit quantized) for the worker. expect ~55-65% cost reduction on embed ops. I can open a PR for the worker config.

priya_re: how are we defining "renewal risk" threshold? proposal: mark red if spend >4x baseline for >7d, orange if >2x for >3d. Orbit is currently 7.2x for 5d.

mike_fin: I'll run a 30/60/90-day projection with and without optimizations and drop numbers in the shared sheet. SQL I usually run: `select date, sum(cost_usd) from usage where account = 'ORBIT-458' group by date order by date;` ETA: EOD.

sam_eng: also add rate-limit rule on their route: `rate_limit_tokens_per_minute: 15000` and create quota alert at 75% of their monthly budget. small change, big behavioral impact.

jess_cs: i can join Orbit for enablement tomorrow 10am PT. i'll prep a 10-min checklist: batching guidance, model switch, and suggested prompt examples for smaller chunks.

mike_fin: FYI — pushed an initial forecast to the shared workbook: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/ORBIT-burn-forecast (set to comment-only for now).

ana_chen: action items recap: Mike = forecast + sheet (EOD). Sam = PR for worker config + rate limit (tom). Jess = enablement call (tom 10am PT). Priya = apply renewal risk tag if threshold met (automation or manual). I'll update the account runbook and QBR slides after we have the forecast. :thumbsup:

ana_chen: anyone see blockers?

mike_fin: nothing blocking from finance side, just need read access to stack logs to validate model switch impact.

sam_eng: i'll include a small sampling job in the PR so we can A/B cost before rolling.

ana_chen: cool — thanks everyone. i'll ping again once forecast numbers are in.
